packet.title: Swift core (implementation, here)
packet.summary: Adds the Swift binding’s core: a root Package.swift, a module map over sxml_host.h imported internally, the XPath API in Swift 6 and ctest swift/linux.

body.p: (): done as below; the Swift line (6.7 to 6.9) resumes from bindings/swift/DESIGN.md. Done 2026-10-20 (): Package.swift, bindings/swift/ (module map, Sources/Sxml, 27 tests), ctest swift/linux over a merged libsxml_host.a; Swift 6.2 on Linux, 0 leaks. After and . Owns:

item.p: Package.swift at the repository root (SwiftPM needs it there);

bindings/swift/CMakeLists.txt, which builds sxml_host and adds the ctest swift/linux running swift test with the include and library paths of the build tree. The manifest reads SXML_HOST_LIBRARY_PATH for them; without it, Apple platforms use the XCFramework of 6.9.

body.p: The Swift code uses Swift 6 language mode. CSxmlHost is imported with internal import, so no C type appears in the module's interface. Done when swift/linux passes the XPath half of the parity list and the ARC tests with 0 leaks. Golden: src/index.ts; the probe's module map.
